title: Building Chips in America Act
summary: Federal law signed October 2, 2024 that exempts certain CHIPS-supported semiconductor projects from NEPA review.

data.policy_id: S. 2228 / Building Chips in America Act of 2023
data.name: Building Chips in America Act
data.text: Exempts qualifying CHIPS-supported semiconductor projects from specified National Environmental Policy Act review requirements.

caveats: The WEF article summarizes the law and industry positions; it is not evidence that WEF drafted or lobbied for the legislation.
